'''Green''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] under [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].

==Biography==
Although Xizor considered humans treacherous and untrustful, the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]] selected Green as a Vigo primarily because of the Human's network of spies, blackmailers and racketeers, and a few [[slavery/Legends|slavers]] and [[spice/Legends|spice]] [[Drug dealer|dealers]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. He had a grudge against [[Wendell Wright-Sims]], who managed to monopolize [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="sotesb" /> Few of Green's rackets were sufficiently profitable in Xizor's eyes.

Green operated in [[Metharian Nebula Territories|the region]] around [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] and sometimes employed the services of [[bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], through [[Chorh-dha]], [[Vimriss]] and others of his agents.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=Bounty's Due|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Chorh-dha, was actually a double agent, belonging also to Rodian [[Clezo]]'s organization, and reported Green's activities to Clezo. Green's [[Sublieutenant/Legends|Sublieutenants]] were also [[agent/Legends|agents]] of Vigo [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Durga had his own plans and had an elaborate scheme to subvert the other Vigos against Xizor (and take his place). Green therefore who was subtly pushed by his sublieutenants, having ambitions to undermine the [[Underlord]]'s authority. He started a long series of plots, became less loyal, and paid less to Xizor; Green's ambitions were well known to Xizor,<ref name="sotesb" /> but was not considered a credible threat.

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an ex-employee of Vigo Green retired on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] where he bought a patch of land to raise large creatures. As this employee still owed money to Green and failed to comply with certain payment arrangements, the Vigo recruited a group of discreet gunmen to teach him a lesson. The [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] thus traveled to the property and slayed any creatures they could find.<ref name="SWG:EIoaP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Extract Interest on a Payment}} on Corellia</ref>

[[File:GreenDeath-SOTETC.jpg|thumb|left|Green's death]]
Eventually, Xizor discovered that Green was spying on Black Sun for an unknown outside organization.<ref name="guri">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Beautiful... and Lethal|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC009.jpg}}</ref><ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> He summoned all his Vigos to [[Xizor's Palace|his Palace]], and they all complied. They all gathered in the antechamber, and were relieved of their weapons by [[Howzmin]]. Everyone knew that Xizor discovered something and wanted to make an example of the culpit to the remaining eight of them. As for Green, he wondered if his plans had been discovered, and displayed some nervousness until they were summoned by [[Guri]].<ref>{{WEGCite|story=The Obvious Scapegoat|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> Indeed, at the conclusion of the meeting, Xizor had [[Guri]] [[Death/Legends|kill]] Green in front of the other Vigos as an example.<ref name="guri" /><ref name="novel" />

His position was subsequently given to another [[Human/Legends|Human]] who, unbeknownst to the council, was actually Xizor's niece [[Savan]] in disguise.

==Personality and traits==
Green was middle-aged during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and his hair was graying and receding. He had a pale and guilty look, like someone hunted or caught.<ref name="sotesb" />

Green's lavish dress reflected his belief that such costumes gained him the respect of his underlings.<ref name="sotesb" />

As a Vigo, Green became antagonistic and tried to outdo his peers. Yes he was easily manipulated by other agents, and unware he was serving their schemes. He was also the last to learn that his activities were monitored, and while his underlings were aware that Xizor knew his plots, he was not.<ref name="sotesb" />
